svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
each known letter keyed by the known letter 3 places before it
place 25: T keyed by E (place 22) carves I; the copper has V
every lag from 1 to 96, all 24 ways of using the table
no two known letters that far apart
lag 12: one check, one way of using the table
OUT: NO READING; THE MESSAGE CANNOT BE BUILT WITHOUT ITS FIRST LETTERS
